info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status Retrieval API provides consumers with the ability to access and monitor the status of pets available for adoption. This endpoint allows users to query the current status of multiple pets, enabling them to make informed decisions regarding pet adoption. Typical consumers may include animal shelters, adoption agencies, and potential pet adopters looking to view available pets and their statuses. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their operations and enhance the adoption process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of various pets, helping to track their health and availability.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the status of the pets that you want to retrieve. Ensure that the content adheres to the expected schema and includes all required attributes.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of pets.

ListPetadoptionPetsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status of the pets as a string. It is used as the request body for the GET operation on the pets' status.
